items.title: CVE-2026-97785: Microsoft Entra Application Proxy Improper Authentication
items.summary: Unauthenticated attackers can read and tamper with data in Entra Application Proxy.

items.title: CVE-2026-83941: Microsoft Entra Missing Authorization
items.summary: Low-privileged users can escalate privileges in Microsoft Entra due to missing authorization checks.

items.title: CVE-2026-62916: Microsoft Entra Authentication Bypass
items.summary: Unauthenticated attackers can bypass authentication in Microsoft Entra, leading to privilege escalation.

items.title: CVE-2026-84672: Jenkins Microsoft Entra ID Plugin Vulnerability
items.summary: Attackers can create Entra groups with colliding display names to gain unauthorized permissions.

items.title: CVE-2026-56155: Microsoft ADFS Cloud Identity Privilege Escalation
items.summary: Low-privileged users can forge SAML tokens, bypassing MFA across hybrid cloud tenants.
